name: Scenario A: Customer Booking Flow
description: Handles inbound Freshchat messages containing booking keywords. Uses Claude (OpenRouter) to extract booking intent, checks Google Calendar availability for the specific requested time slot, creates events or suggests alternatives, and sends confirmation via Freshchat and Resend. Error handling sends alerts to brian@cwiai.net. Timezone: America/New_York (Eastern Time).

webhooks.name: Freshchat Booking Webhook
webhooks.notes: Make generates the real webhook URL when the scenario is imported and the CustomWebHook trigger (module 1, hook: 1001) is activated. Copy that URL and register it in Freshchat Admin > Settings > Webhooks > New Message.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.label: OpenRouter API Key
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.notes: Referenced as env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Used for Claude API calls via OpenRouter.

FRESHCHAT_API_KEY.label: Freshchat API Key
FRESHCHAT_API_KEY.notes: Referenced as env.FRESHCHAT_API_KEY. Freshchat account API token from Admin > API Tokens.

FRESHCHAT_WEBHOOK_ID.label: Freshchat Webhook Hook ID
FRESHCHAT_WEBHOOK_ID.notes: Referenced as env.FRESHCHAT_WEBHOOK_ID. Auto-generated by Make.com when the CustomWebHook trigger is configured. Register the Make webhook URL in Freshchat Admin > Webhooks.

FRESHCHAT_BOT_ID.label: Freshchat Bot/Agent ID
FRESHCHAT_BOT_ID.notes: Referenced as env.FRESHCHAT_BOT_ID. The agent or bot actor_id used to send outbound messages via the Freshchat API.

GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.label: Google Calendar ID
GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.notes: Referenced as env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID. Primary calendar ID (e.g. primary or full calendar email).

RESEND_API_KEY.label: Resend API Key
RESEND_API_KEY.notes: Referenced as env.RESEND_API_KEY. Resend API key for native HTTP email sends (replaces all Gmail/SMTP).

RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS.label: Resend From Address
RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS.notes: Referenced as env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS. Verified sender, e.g. 'CWI AI <brian@cwiai.net>'.

CALENDLY_BOOKING_LINK.label: Calendly Booking Link
CALENDLY_BOOKING_LINK.notes: Referenced as env.CALENDLY_BOOKING_LINK. Primary self-service booking URL surfaced in the bot.

RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT.label: Resend Client-Facing From Address
RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT.notes: Referenced as env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS. Verified client-facing sender (NEVER brian@cwiai.net). Used as FROM on all customer emails.

RESEND_REPLY_TO.label: Resend Reply-To Address
RESEND_REPLY_TO.notes: Referenced as env.RESEND_REPLY_TO. Reply-to address on all Resend emails (client confirmations and internal alerts).

CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.label: Internal Alert From Address
CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS.notes: Referenced as env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Verified sender used as FROM on internal error-alert emails to brian@cwiai.net.

OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL.label: OpenRouter Fallback Model
OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL.notes: Referenced as env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL. Secondary model id used by OpenRouter route:fallback when the primary anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 returns 429/503.

HUBSPOT_API_KEY.label: HubSpot Private App Token
HUBSPOT_API_KEY.notes: Referenced as env.HUBSPOT_API_KEY. HubSpot private app access token with crm.objects.meetings.write and crm.objects.deals.write scopes.

HUBSPOT_DEAL_ID.label: HubSpot Deal ID
HUBSPOT_DEAL_ID.notes: Referenced as env.HUBSPOT_DEAL_ID. ID of the deal to advance after a successful booking. In production, resolve dynamically by contact email.

HUBSPOT_STAGE_CALL_BOOKED.label: HubSpot Deal Stage — Call Booked
HUBSPOT_STAGE_CALL_BOOKED.notes: Referenced as env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CALL_BOOKED. Pipeline stage ID the deal is moved to once the appointment is confirmed.

notes.label: Module 1 — Freshchat Webhook Trigger
notes.note: Fires instantly on any new Freshchat message. The keyword filter (book, schedule, appointment, available, availability, come out) ensures only booking-intent messages proceed. Register the Make webhook URL in Freshchat Admin > Settings > Webhooks > New Message.

notes.label: Module 2 — OpenRouter / Claude: Extract Booking Intent
notes.note: Sends the raw message to Claude (claude-sonnet-4-6 via OpenRouter). System prompt instructs the model to return ONLY a JSON object with preferred_date, preferred_time, and service_type. Low temperature (0.1) ensures deterministic extraction.

notes.label: Module 3 — Parse JSON
notes.note: Parses the raw text response from Claude into a structured JSON object so downstream modules can reference {{3.preferred_date}}, {{3.preferred_time}}, and {{3.service_type}}.

notes.label: Module 4 — Google Calendar: List Events (Specific Slot Overlap)
notes.note: Queries the calendar ONLY for the specific requested time window: timeMin = preferred_date + preferred_time, timeMax = that time + 60 minutes, timeZone America/New_York. Google Calendar listEvents returns only events that overlap this window, so length(4.items)==0 means the exact requested slot is free (true time-slot overlap check, not a whole-day check).

notes.label: Router — Branch A (Available) / Branch B (Busy)
notes.note: Branch A filter (single AND array): length(4.items) == 0 AND preferred_time != empty (the exact requested slot is free and a time was extracted). Branch B filter: length(4.items) > 0 (an event overlaps the requested slot). Bot replies 'checking availability now...' and offers the Calendly link as the primary self-service booking path.

notes.label: Branch A — Modules 6-12 (Slot Available, Book + CRM)
notes.note: After the slot is confirmed free: (6) create the Google Calendar event, (7) send the Freshchat confirmation, (8) send the Resend confirmation email (from env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS, reply_to env.RESEND_REPLY_TO — never brian@cwiai.net as FROM), (11) log a HubSpot meeting engagement tied to the created event, (12) advance the HubSpot deal to env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CALL_BOOKED. The word 'confirmed' appears ONLY after module 6 has actually created the event — never before the calendar overlap check.

notes.label: OpenRouter Resilience — Modules 2 & 9
notes.note: Both OpenRouter calls use route:fallback with models:[anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, env.OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODEL] and provider.allow_fallbacks:true, so a 429/503 on the primary Claude Sonnet 4-6 model automatically retries on the fallback model id. Primary AI model is always anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6.

notes.label: Error Handler
notes.note: Attached to ALL modules. On any error: (1) sends a detailed HTML alert email to brian@cwiai.net via Resend including the error type, module ID, and all extracted customer/booking data; (2) sends an apology message (with Calendly link) to the customer's Freshchat conversation; (3) assigns the conversation to a human agent.
